title: Customer Account Standards: Holding Several Replacement System Installations Projects
content:
# Several installation projects for one household

**Standard.** A homeowner may hold more than one Replacement System Installations project, one per system replaced at the service address. There is no cap on the number of projects one customer may hold. Each project is priced, paid, financed, cancelled and closed on its own.

An address with an upstairs and a downstairs system commonly signs two contracts at once; each of those contracts is its own project.

## What "on its own" covers

| Matter | Treated per project |
|---|---|
| Price | Each project carries its own contract price. |
| Payments | Payments are recorded on the project they are made toward. |
| Financing | Each project is financed on its own. |
| Cancellation | Cancelling one project is a matter for that project. |
| Close-out | Each project closes on its own. |

## Points of judgement

- One project corresponds to one system replaced; two systems replaced at one address are two projects.
- Holding several projects places no limit on signing another one.
- The status, balance and ledger of one project say nothing about the status, balance or ledger of another project of the same homeowner.
